nodes.text: [i]The red ink stops being a voice. It pulls itself together into something with edges, and the edges are pointed at you.[/i]

nodes.speaker: The Critic
nodes.text: Fine. FINE. You remembered. Do you think that makes it GOOD?
[i]It is still the Critic, and it is still very loud. But you held up what it was built to drown out, and now it has a shape, and shapes can be struck. Raise the Quill.[/i]
